overnight_intraday_reversal: Stocks whose cumulative overnight return over the past 20 days exceeds their cumulative intraday return (i.e., gains concentrated overnight) underperform over the next 5 trading days; the reverse holds for stocks whose gains are concentrated intraday.
close_position_persistence: Stocks with a high average close_position (close near the daily high) over the past 20 days outperform stocks with low average close_position over the next 5 trading days.
range_contraction_breakout: Stocks whose 20-day average high-low range is low relative to their 120-day average range (range compression) outperform over the next 20 trading days, with the effect stronger when recent 20-day return is positive.
dollar_volume_shock_reversal: Stocks with abnormally high 5-day dollar volume relative to their 60-day average dollar volume underperform over the next 5 trading days.
overnight_gap_fade: Stocks with the largest positive overnight gaps (top of cross-sectional distribution) over the past 5 days underperform over the next 5 trading days, and stocks with the largest negative gaps outperform.
intraday_momentum_continuation: Stocks with high cumulative intraday_return over the past 20 days outperform over the next 20 trading days.
